# UI Skeleton, Evaluation & Security Gates Checklist: UI Skeleton & Quality Gates

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality validation ("Unit Tests for English") covering the adaptive 3-column Single-Page Application workspace layout (`FR-UI-01`), the automated grounding/citation/rejection/scoping evaluation suite (`NFR-EVAL-01..04`, `Gate v1.0`), and enterprise no-training security compliance (`NFR-SEC-01`, `D14`).
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all three functional workspace panels (`Sources` on the left, `Chat` in the center, `Studio` on the right) and the top navigation header specified with their v1.0 responsibilities and placeholder states? [Completeness, Spec §R01 — FR-UI-01]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all three responsive viewport breakpoints specified: desktop $\ge 1280\text{ px}$ (3 columns, both side panels expanded), laptop $1024\text{–}1279\text{ px}$ (3 columns, `Studio` panel initially collapsed), and tablet/mobile $< 1024\text{ px}$ (tabbed navigation `Sources | Chat | Studio`)? [Completeness, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §R01 — FR-UI-01]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification define all four evaluation gate metrics (`NFR-EVAL-01` grounding faithfulness, `NFR-EVAL-02` citation ID precision and semantic support, `NFR-EVAL-03` negative rejection, `NFR-EVAL-04` strict context scoping) and their required benchmark case counts ($\ge 100$ unanswerable, $\ge 50$ deselection including history carry-over, $\ge 50$ multi-document synthesis)? [Completeness, Spec §R02 — NFR-EVAL-01..04 & NFR-SEC-01]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification require verifiable enterprise no-training coverage (`NFR-SEC-01`) across all LLM, OCR, and embedding endpoints while prohibiting consumer/developer API keys? [Completeness, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §R02 — NFR-EVAL-01..04 & NFR-SEC-01, Spec §Cross-package requirements CP-06]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK005 Are the exact pass/fail boundary inequalities for `Gate v1.0 #2` unambiguously defined ($\epsilon_{\text{hallucination}} < 0.05$ where $0.05$ fails, $\text{Precision}_{\text{ID}} = 1.00$ where $0.99$ fails, negative rejection $\ge 0.99$ where $0.99$ passes, and $\text{Leakage} = 0$ where any nonzero chunk count fails)? [Clarity, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §R02 — NFR-EVAL-01..04 & NFR-SEC-01]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the distinction between the $\epsilon_{\text{hallucination}} < 0.05$ release gate threshold and the $\le 0.02$ target clearly stated so that the target is not substituted for the gate threshold? [Clarity, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §R02 — NFR-EVAL-01..04 & NFR-SEC-01]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the v1.0 `Studio` right-panel placeholder text (`"Notes and Studio tools will appear here"`) and absence of any `Contract C-03` generator tiles in `v1.0` explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §Assumptions & Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the separation between enterprise no-training policy verification (`NFR-SEC-01`) and zero-data-retention claims explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §Cross-package requirements CP-06, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Consistency & Contract Alignment

- [ ] CHK009 Do `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `contracts/interfaces.md` consistently require that passing `NFR-EVAL-01..04` (`Gate v1.0 #2`) leaves full `Gate v1.0` pending until end-to-end PDF/MD `C-01` chunk validation (`Gate v1.0 #1`) and deterministic citation-to-inspector scrolling (`Gate v1.0 #3`) also pass? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Success Criteria SC-CROSS]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the CI execution cadence consistent across `spec.md` and `plan.md` (deterministic `NFR-EVAL-02` ID precision and `NFR-EVAL-04` leakage checks on every PR; LLM-judged `NFR-EVAL-01`, `NFR-EVAL-02` semantic support, and `NFR-EVAL-03` suites on retrieval/prompt/chat PRs and every release gate)? [Consistency, Spec §Success Criteria SC-CADENCE, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK011 Are dark/light mode and per-notebook language selection consistently deferred to `v2.0` (`FR-UI-02`), and `@Notebook` integration deferred by `D5`/`DEV-03` (`FR-INT-01`)? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions & Out of Scope]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [ ] CHK012 Is the panel expand/collapse transition requirement ($\le 200\text{ ms}$ at $60\text{ fps}$ with zero layout-shift data loss and preserved chat input draft and scroll position) objectively testable? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the specification require the evaluation runner to exit with a non-zero status code and log the exact failing test case IDs against the build commit (`eval-report-v1.json`) whenever any single metric misses its threshold? [Measurability, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Key Entities]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Is the interaction between a collapsed `Sources` left panel (or narrow-viewport tab state) and clicking an inline citation `[1]` in `Chat` specified so that the `Sources` panel automatically un-collapses/activates, widens into the Source Inspector, and scrolls deterministically to `[data-chunk-id]`? [Edge Case, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §Edge Cases FR-UI-01, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the multi-turn deselection carry-over edge case (asking a follow-up question after deselecting a previously cited source) explicitly included in the `NFR-EVAL-04` benchmark requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §R02 — NFR-EVAL-01..04 & NFR-SEC-01]
- [ ] CHK016 Is browser `localStorage` persistence of user panel collapse/expand preferences across page reloads specified alongside default breakpoint behavior when no preference is stored? [Edge Case, Spec §Boundary and security acceptance, Spec §Key Entities]
